My friend Sam is very kind. Nina drinks juice every morning. Nina and Sam are in the same class. Best of all, the soup is too hot.
I like my life very much. I am happy every day. The chess corner is not far from my home. In fact, we spent our holiday on the southern coast.
Sam likes bread too. We often go to the bookstore together. Nina wants to visit Chengdu.
